title: Antecedent
description: Antecedent is a compiler and evidence-aware runtime for causal science, in Python and Rust. It checks what a causal question needs, compiles an analysis that can be inspected, and executes only routes backed by provenance and an independent scientific check, refusing the rest with a typed reason. Each answer carries its identification, uncertainty, calibration status and the published methods it rests on into the comparisons, decisions and further studies that use it.
